integrity.verification_basis: symbolic generator and coordinate recurrences plus polynomial positivity, thermal cumulance and root count

scientific_limitations: Instantaneous spherical uniform orientation redraw; positive tumble rate; harmonic trap; independent isotropic Brownian diffusion.
Full thermal two-root classification is for dimension three; zero-noise uniqueness and dimensional ordering hold for all integer dimensions.
Prior papers provide generic moment and thermal-convolution formulas; novelty is limited to global sign and critical-coalescence classification.
Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
title: Sharp thermal reentrance of stationary trap-energy skewness in an isotropic run-and-tumble particle
